column3: Estinien is eyeing the surroundings carefully.

At Estinien's bidding, you confirm that you are able to use the golden path to return to the Source, but neither he nor Alphinaud can so much as perceive the portal. Setting aside the question of passage home, you and your comrades look to make the most of your presence in the Fourth, to which end you split up to explore the isle.
Your examination of the isle turns up nothing of note, but perhaps the others have had better luck. You go to seek out Estinien to share your findings─or lack thereof.

Estinien reveals that he has similarly discovered nothing, but no sooner does he comment on the need for a means of transport than he notices silhouettes in the distance that appear to be growing larger. Whether they are the answer to your prayers or trouble, however, remains to be seen...

To your dismay, the approaching silhouettes turn out to be a horde of hostile creatures. After fending off wave after wave of attackers, you are set upon by what appears to be their leader. It is at this moment that an airship appears out of the blue. A young skyfarer on board offers to provide you with cover fire, and with her aid you succeed in vanquishing the enemy. With the dust having settled, a word of gratitude would surely not go amiss.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return from Dawn's Respite in the Rising Stones.

What should be a simple expression of thanks turns into a tense encounter due to your ignorance of local customs. But to your relief, the situation is defused when the young skyfarer, Visna, chooses to take a leap of faith and believe your claim that you do not bear “brands.” Astonished that you hail from another world, she explains to you that the people of the Fourth reside on massive vessels─realmships─and offers to take you to hers. There she will introduce you to her master, a man whom she says is knowledgeable about a great many things.

Alphinaud is struck by the harsh circumstances of the Fourth, and is grateful to have met a kind soul such as Visna. He hopes to learn more about how she and her fellow skyfarers live in this world, not least of all to avoid further incidents.
Investigate the surroundings.
Speak with Estinien.
Speak with Estinien again.
Speak with Estinien again.
Speak with Alphinaud.
Whilst not as frigid as Garlemald, it is still quite cold here. Would that I had brought warmer garments...
Player. Can you still use the path created by this “Ethos”?
Our circumstances are more complicated if not even you can return, so we should confirm this before aught else.
Somehow, you sense the presence of your comrades beyond the rift. It should be possible to travel to Dawn's Respite via the path.
While 'tis heartening to know that you can return, I fear the two of us cannot so much as perceive the portal.
But we can worry about our passage home later. For now, let us endeavor to make the most of our presence here.
Whether we seek Calyx and Halmarut or the Winterer of this world, it begins with assessing our own situation. To that end, I propose we split up and explore the isle.
As I suspected, the wind crystals are not merely frozen over─they've been corrupted by ice.
Such a phenomenon is only possible through extreme and prolonged exposure.
The isle is smaller than I thought. There will be little game to be had...
The tree is entirely covered in ice. Though it bathes in the light of the azure skies, it shows no signs of thawing.
In this state, it will not yield so much as firewood.
The ground is frozen solid. There are no footprints or anything else that suggests the presence of others.
At the very least, no one has visited this isle for a long while.
Thick clouds stretch out as far as the eye can see, covering the world's surface like a blanket.
A number of small isles float in the vicinity, but you cannot detect any signs of life on them.
By your expression, I take it you also found naught of note. Quite the quandary...
If we're to get anywhere, we must have some means of transport. If there were at least a large bird or the like...
What's this? Silhouettes in the distance, and they seem to be moving towards us. The answer to our prayers...or trouble?
Something makes its way to the isle, you say? Understood, I shall join you forthwith.
Five shadows... No, more. The numbers grow as we speak. I mislike the looks of this.
Your progress through the battle will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 100 or above to proceed.
Proceed to the unmoored isle?
For a while I wasn't sure how we would fare, but it seems luck was on our side. Now we have an airship...albeit with a slew of caveats.
While I have a mountain of questions myself, looking after you all takes priority. You weren't hurt in the battle, I hope?
This world is far harsher than I had dared to imagine.
To have met someone like Visna was fortunate indeed. We must endeavor to familiarize ourselves with the customs of her world.
Doubly so if we are to meet her master. It wouldn't do to have a repeat of the earlier incident.
